title: China Tax Crackdown Forces Wealthy Investors to Exit Offshore Trusts
detail: China's ongoing tax crackdown is forcing wealthy investors to restructure or exit offshore trusts as scrutiny of cross-border wealth intensifies. Authorities are targeting high-net-worth individuals with overseas assets, prompting a wave of compliance reviews and trust restructurings across jurisdictions including Singapore, Hong Kong, and the Cayman Islands.

media.caption: China's tax crackdown on offshore trusts
